scripts.electron:dev: concurrently -k "cross-env NEXT_PUBLIC_RUNTIME=electron next dev" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 && cross-env ELECTRON_START_URL=http://localhost:3000 electron ."
scripts.electron:preview: cross-env NEXT_PUBLIC_RUNTIME=electron next build && concurrently -k "cross-env NEXT_PUBLIC_RUNTIME=electron next start -p 3000" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 && cross-env ELECTRON_START_URL=http://localhost:3000 electron ."
